title: Common-stage transport of rational normalized constant-unit coherence
statement: Given the rational-stage normalized constant-unit Frobenius coherence for the least finite coefficient field, the prescribed common-stage inclusion and pullback comparison satisfy the corresponding common-stage coherence equation.

source.place: Step 1, passage from rational coefficients to the common stage

proof.text: Represent the common-stage maps at the least finite coefficient stage and expand the defining representative formulas for the common pullback and inclusion.
Transport the rational coherence equation through the inclusion functor; the recorded eqToIso object comparisons cancel by functoriality and proof irrelevance.

proof_origin.place: Step 1, passage from rational coefficients to the common stage

mathlib_searches.query: The canonical pullback identification of constant sheaves respects composition and geometric Frobenius
mathlib_searches.results: constantCommuteCompose and sheaf-module pullbackComp concern ordinary sheaves. No common-stage normalized unit or normalized geometric Frobenius compositor equality.

mathlib_searches.query: Two common-stage derived pullback composition isomorphisms normalized by the same integral composition are equal
mathlib_searches.results: Categorical pullback pasting and mkNatIso_eq. None compares these integral-normalized scalar-localized common-stage maps.
Ordinary scheme-module and site pullback unit and composition APIs; no normalized completed, rational or common-stage coefficient-unit Frobenius square.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageDerivedPullback_map_inclusion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω)
    (P Q : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω Y L)
    (a : P ⟶ Q) :
    HEq
      ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion L).map a))
      ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion L).map
        ((rationalDerivedPullback l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).map a))
